thread:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT: High outgoing QPS from org 'NucleusAI' detected (sustained 4x baseline). Paging @oncall-anna :rotating_light:
oncall-anna: Saw the alert, joining. pulling recent dashboards now.
eng-sre-ben: I can help with live mitigation. What tier and quota does NucleusAI have?
support-alejandro: NucleusAI is on Enterprise Reserved (dedicated pool), soft qps=500, hard quota=1200/min — they are hitting ~2200 QPS per minute on text-gen.
oncall-anna: OK. Start live triage: 1) confirm customer impact 2) apply short-term rl adjustment 3) mitigate risky features.
customer-success-lia: I just got a PM from their infra lead — some jobs misfired and they see timeouts downstream. They request minimum disruption.
eng-sre-ben: Timeline: spike started 05:03 UTC. Origin appears to be increased parallel inference (multiple small requests). Likely an orchestrator bug.
infra-maya: Routing note: dedicated pool is saturated in us-west1. We have spare capacity in us-central1 but cross-region adds latency.
oncall-anna: Suggested immediate actions: a) temp qps bump for NucleusAI to 1.5k per minute for 30m b) enable per-token throttling on high-cost endpoints c) disable realtime streaming for that org as fallback. Thoughts?
support-alejandro: I'd prefer smaller bump + feature disable to avoid long tail cost. They agreed to disable streaming if we ask.
eng-sre-ben: If we do CLI hotfix: `redwood org adjust-qps --org nucleusai --qps 1500 --ttl 30m --note "emergency spike 05:10 UTC"` — that should take effect on control plane within ~20s.
oncall-anna: Go ahead ben, I'll coordinate comms.
eng-sre-ben: Running now: `> redwood org adjust-qps --org nucleusai --qps 1500 --ttl 30m --note "emergency spike 05:10 UTC"`
pagerduty-bot: ACTION LOGGED: adjust-qps by eng-sre-ben at 8190012360
eng-sre-ben: API response: 200 OK, config rollout started. Propagating to dedicated pool.
infra-maya: Confirmed pool scaled policy applied; ephemeral routing to us-central1 started for lower-priority flows.
customer-success-lia: Informed customer: "We've applied a temporary QPS increase and disabled streaming for 30 minutes to stabilize. Monitoring now"
support-alejandro: Disabling streaming for NucleusAI: `redwood org feature-toggle --org nucleusai --feature streaming --state off --ttl 30m` — executing.
eng-sre-ben: Streaming toggle accepted, control plane reports success.
oncall-anna: Monitoring metrics: 05:12 UTC incoming QPS dropped to ~1.6k then 1.4k; error rate reduced from 8% -> 1.2%. Good signal.
customer-success-lia: Customer reporting fewer downstream timeouts, but some retry flurries. They requested ETA for full resolution.
oncall-anna: We need a postmortem path: short-term (30m actions) then root-cause. Assigning follow-ups: eng-sre-ben (mitigation + rollout validation), infra-maya (capacity/placement), support-alejandro (customer comms), customer-success-lia (account updates).
eng-sre-ben: Noted. I'll also add a temporary per-request size cap on text-gen to reduce amplification: `redwood org set-rate-limit --org nucleusai --param max_tokens_per_req 1024 --ttl 30m`
pagerduty-bot: ACTION LOGGED: feature-toggle and param update by support-alejandro and eng-sre-ben at 8190012405
eng-sre-ben: Param applied. Observability: tail logs show fewer simultaneous KV cache misses.
oncall-anna: Great. Plan to revert toggles at 05:40 UTC unless we see re-spike. We'll keep a short postmortem and recommend an org-level quota increase or client-side rate limiter fix.
customer-success-lia: I'll schedule a customer sync and propose a safe committed QPS increase if they expect higher baseline.
support-alejandro: Saving runbook notes under incident-8190012345 for SRE oncall handoff.
eng-sre-ben: One more mitigation option if spike resumes: fail-fast on requests with >1k tokens and return 429 with guidance header. That's last-resort.
oncall-anna: Good. I'll start a handoff to the night oncall at 05:35 UTC. If anything changes ping this thread.
infra-maya: We'll also audit autoscaling thresholds; dedicated pool didn't autoscale as early as expected.
eng-sre-ben: Adding a temporary alert to page SRE if qps > 1800 for more than 3m after TTL expiry.
customer-success-lia: Customer says their deploy includes a retry bug fix rolling out now; they asked to be notified before we revert streaming.
oncall-anna: Acknowledged. Revert plan: 1) check QPS < 900 for 10m 2) re-enable streaming 3) drop emergency qps override. I'll confirm before any revert.
support-alejandro: All actions logged. Closing initial mitigation stage.
eng-sre-ben: Leaving note: follow-up RCA to include request fanout analysis and client-side concurrency guidance.
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity lowered to S2 at 8190012610. Mitigations active.
oncall-anna: Thanks team. Handoff to night oncall when TTL nears expiry.
customer-success-lia: I'll keep the customer in the loop. :handshake:
